article.headline: San Antonio plays Boston, seeks 4th straight home win
article.description: Boston Celtics (12-7, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (16-4, first in the Western Conference)
article.title: San Antonio plays Boston, seeks 4th straight home win
article.linkText: San Antonio plays Boston, seeks 4th straight home win
article.story: Boston Celtics (12-7, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (16-4, first in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Sunday, 4 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio will try to keep its three-game home win streak intact when the Spurs face Boston. The Spurs are 8-3 on their home court. San Antonio is fifth in the Western Conference scoring 116.4 points while shooting 46.3% from the field. The Celtics are 6-5 in road games. Boston has a 3-5 record against opponents over .500. The Spurs' 12.4 made 3-pointers per game this season are just 0.9 fewer made shots on average than the 13.3 per game the Celtics give up. The Celtics average 5.4 more points per game (110.9) than the Spurs give up (105.5). TOP PERFORMERS: Victor Wembanyama is averaging 30.4 points, 12.7 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 3.7 blocks for the Spurs. Stephon Castle is averaging 19.1 points and 7.9 assists over the last 10 games. Jayson Tatum is scoring 26.9 points per game with 6.9 rebounds and 6.7 assists for the Celtics. Paul George is averaging 15.7 points and 4.2 rebounds while shooting 46.4% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Spurs: 8-2, averaging 114.3 points, 48.1 rebounds, 29.2 assists, 8.4 steals and 5.6 blocks per game while shooting 47.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 102.9 points per game. Celtics: 5-5, averaging 107.5 points, 46.3 rebounds, 24.9 assists, 9.0 steals and 4.7 blocks per game while shooting 43.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 99.3 points. INJURIES: Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). Celtics: Mitchell Robinson: out (illness). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
